International Paper Company Files Current Report on Form 8-K

MEMPHIS, Tenn.--  International Paper Company (the "Company") has filed a Current Report on Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") disclosing that on 8 October 2026, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of the Company, upon the recommendation of the Company's Governance Committee, appointed Katherine Collins to the Audit & Finance and Safety, Technology and Sustainability committees and Lori J. Ryerkerk to the Governance and Management Development & Compensation committees effective 1 October 2026.

Further details about the appointment can be found on the SEC Filings page of the Company's website (www.internationalpaper.com) at SEC Filings | International Paper and on the SEC's website at  https://www.sec.gov.
The person responsible for arranging for the release of this announcement on behalf of the Company is Joseph R. Saab, Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary.
About International Paper (NYSE: IP; LSE: IPC)

International Paper creates sustainable packaging solutions that enable our customers, teammates and shareowners to thrive in an ever-changing world. We are a leader in corrugated packaging, partnering with customers across industries to protect what matters most, strengthen supply chains and create lasting value. Learn more at internationalpaper.com.
